full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 49
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Agenda
Friday, Shrawan 22, 2083
1:00 PM
1. Presentation of Committee Report on Bill
Honorable Chairperson Hari Dhakal of the State Affairs and Good Governance Committee will present the "Report of the Committee on the Bill to Revive the Previous Provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042, 2083".
2. Management Work
On behalf of the Right Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will:
(a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Bill to Amend the Remuneration, Service Conditions and Facilities of Office Bearers of Constitutional Bodies (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) Introduce the "Bill to Amend the Remuneration, Service Conditions and Facilities of Office Bearers of Constitutional Bodies (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
3. Honorable Minister for Foreign Affairs Shishir Khanal will:
(a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Passport (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) Introduce the "Passport (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
4. Honorable Minister for Women, Children, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Intersex and Social Security Sita Poudel will:
(a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) Introduce the "Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
5. Honorable Minister for Industry, Commerce and Supplies Gauri Kumari will:
(a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Mine and Minerals Bill, 2083".
(b) Introduce the "Mine and Minerals Bill, 2083".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
